title: Retro gaming is being overrun with AI
slides: Who's actually playing all these AI retro games?
Storefronts now overflow with thousands of AI-made clones
Most are auto-generated in hours, not authentic fan works
Your favorite classics get buried under algorithmic noise
Search by hand for real gems—skip the feed
thread_text:
1. The AI Clone Flood

Thousands of auto-generated retro game clones now flood storefronts, made in hours by bots—not fans. Your favorite classics are getting buried alive.

2. Fans vs. Algorithms

Authentic fan works take weeks. These AI clones take hours. The algorithm doesn't care about quality—it just feeds the volume.

3. Discovery Is Broken

Search results now surface algorithmic noise first. Real gems slip further down the page every day, invisible to casual players.

4. The Human Filter

Scrolling the feed won't save you—the feed is rigged. Finding real games means digging manually through pages of auto-generated junk.

5. Search by Hand

Next time you browse, skip the recommended feed. Search specific titles or dev names manually. Does the algorithm ever show you something genuinely good anymore?
